name: ss_mpc
description: SS-MPC (Jang et al., 2025): multi-party response generation that encodes the reply-to / speaker / addressee structure as sequential special-token input to a plain BART (no graph encoder) -- encoder post-training on masked index/speaker tokens, then fine-tuning. The authors' own code is vendored and run unmodified by train.py; this method generates from the final checkpoint (max_length 50) on ubuntu_irc_gen. Needs pytorch-lightning + evaluate (ss_mpc extra) and a GPU.
author: Wnsdnl
